title: IndexUpdateRequested
description: Event emitted to request legal-search to update its OpenSearch index. Can be triggered by document-intelligence after processing or by an operational reindex workflow.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was emitted.

document_ids.description: Specific document IDs to reindex (for scope 'document' or 'incremental').

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the reindex request.
